data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding balance of GBP 95.413m at 1 January 2016. The report states "In 2016 the surplus was GBP 14.6m," indicating overall favourable prior-year claims development (a release). Although 2016 experienced a series of large catastrophe losses (e.g. Hurricane Matthew, Alberta fires, New Zealand earthquake) which impacted the calendar year underwriting results, prior-year reserves produced a net release as reported. No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was located in the movement note; the report's stated GBP 14.6m surplus (used here as the quantified prior-year movement) appears to be net of reinsurance and is used as a fallback.
raw_causal_phrases: 2016 saw a series of large losses which severely impacted the calendar year combined ratio
These losses included Hurricane Matthew, fires in Alberta, and the New Zealand Earthquake.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves and gross written premiums were taken from the balance sheet and segmental analysis (pages 14 and 22 respectively). A gross prior-year movement figure (movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding in the Insurance liabilities / gross column) could not be unambiguously located/extracted from the notes in the scanned pages. The report explicitly states "In 2016 the surplus was GBP 14.6m." That sentence has been used as a quantified prior-year movement as a NET-of-reinsurance fallback because no clear gross prior year movement amount was found. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is the reported GBP 14.6m surplus (treated as a release = negative sign) and is NET of reinsurance; this is a fallback and may understate the gross movement. The claims development triangle is present in the report but the scanned images made precise gross triangle extraction unreliable; triangle data is therefore not fully reconstructed here.
